title: Implement TypeScript Conditional Types
description: Create a conditional type called `ElementType<T>` that extracts the type of elements from an array type. For example, `ElementType<string[]>` should resolve to `string`, and `ElementType<number[]>` should resolve to `number`. If T is not an array, it should return `never`.

title: Create a ReadOnly Mapped Type
description: Implement a `ReadOnly<T>` mapped type that makes all properties of an object readonly. This should work similar to TypeScript's built-in `Readonly` utility type.

title: Implement Pick Utility Type
description: Create a `MyPick<T, K>` utility type that works like TypeScript's built-in `Pick` type. It should construct a type with only the properties K from type T.

title: Implement a Simple Counter with useState
description: Create a simple React counter component that uses the useState hook. The component should render a count value and two buttons: one to increment and one to decrement the count.

title: Implement Data Fetching with useEffect
description: Create a React component that fetches data from an API when it mounts. Use the useEffect hook to perform the data fetching and useState to store the fetched data. The component should display a loading state while fetching and the data once it's loaded.

title: Implement a Todo List with useReducer
description: Create a React component that implements a simple todo list using the useReducer hook. The component should allow adding new todos, toggling todo completion status, and removing todos.

title: Optimize Performance with useMemo
description: Create a React component that displays a list of filtered items based on a search term. Use the useMemo hook to optimize the filtering operation so it only runs when the search term or the list changes.

title: Optimize Child Components with useCallback
description: Create a React component that renders a list of items and a button to add new items. Use the useCallback hook to memoize the add item function to prevent unnecessary re-renders of child components.

title: Create a Custom useLocalStorage Hook
description: Implement a custom React hook called useLocalStorage that synchronizes a state value with localStorage. The hook should work similar to useState but persist the value in localStorage.

title: Type-Safe React Component Props
description: Create a TypeScript React component with properly typed props. The component should accept a list of items, a filter function, and a render prop for customizing how each item is displayed.
